south-pacific-west-2014.notes: Source 1 is a general site crawl whose seed page is a 2016 Western Division page; kept as a medium-confidence confirm because it holds the 2014 divisional pages. Earlier reader flagged year-reused.

sources.evidence: Our copy holds the 2014 Western Divisional Contest page, the 2014 South Pacific Region Contests overview and the 2014 problem sets page, though its first page is a later Western Division page.
Table headed Western Division Scoreboard with rank, team, score and columns A to K holding tries and time, last update 2 Sep 2014.
Table of 30 rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation for the Western Division.
23-page PDF titled International Collegiate Programming Contest South Pacific, Western Division 2014 listing problems A to K.

south-pacific-west-2016.notes: Source 4 is a list of the six qualifying teams, not standings; roles corrected to teams.

sources.evidence: The pages are the organisers' 2016 South Pacific Region Contests pages with a report on the divisional contest of Saturday 8th October and links to scoreboard, problems and divisions.
Table of 69 team rows with columns rank, team, score and problems A to L, headed 'All Divisions 2016 Final Standings'.
Table of 30 ranked teams with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time for ACM South Pacific Western Division.
The page is headed 'Teams Qualifying for the Regional Final' and lists six teams with members, with no ranks or scores.
28-page PDF titled 'ACM ICPC South Pacific Divisionals October 8, 2016' with twelve problems A to L.
Page headed '2016 Problem Sets' linking the divisional and regional final problem sets, data and analyses.

south-pacific-west-2017.notes: The pack's problem list contains a stray entry '63: total teams' that inflates the problem count to 13; the scoreboard has 12 problems (A-L). 63 is the number of teams on the combined board, not the Western Division.

sources.evidence: The crawl holds the organisers' 2017 South Pacific Region pages, with the Western Division page dated Saturday 14th October 2017, the divisional report, problem sets and Regional Final pages.
Table of 63 team rows with columns rank, team, score and problems A to L, headed 'Divisional Contest 2017 Final Standings'.
Table of 23 ranked teams with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time and Citation for ACM South Pacific Western Division.

south-pacific-west-2018.notes: Source 1 is the organisers' site as it stood before the contest (home page announces the 20 October divisional); division pages still show 2017 dates. Medal column of source 2 reads Honourable mention in all 22 rows.

sources.evidence: The site's home page is headed 'Contests 2018' and lists the South Pacific Divisional Contests on October 20th and the Regional Final on November 23-24th.
Table of 22 ranked teams with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Medal, Citation and Site citation for South Pacific Western Division.
26-page PDF titled 'ICPC South Pacific Divisionals October 20, 2018' with twelve problems A to L.

south-pacific-west-2019.notes: Source 1 copy lacks the style sheets and flag images it references (assets folder holds only the favicon).

sources.evidence: Table headed 'South Pacific Divisionals 2019 Final Results' with 74 ranked team rows, columns rank, team, score and problems A to M, and Central, East, West and Unofficial categories.
Table of 19 ranked teams with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Medal, Citation and Site citation for South Pacific Western Division.
30-page PDF titled 'ICPC South Pacific Divisionals September 21, 2019' with thirteen problems A to M.
